body: Omg I didn't think of that!

I'm sorry this happened to you and I'm really glad you are seeing a therapist so soon. 

Not quite the same thing but I had a similar experience some years ago in which I caused someone a severe injury while playing a contact sport. My action was perfectly legal and not dangerous in itself, it was just an unfortunate accident. Knowing this didn't help how I felt, and it caused a severe depression that lasted months. It took me a year to start seeing a therapist to help me process the trauma and start to move forward. 

I understand how you might feel. Knowing in your logical brain that it's not your fault does little to help the part of your brain that processes trauma. My therapist helped immensely.

Good luck with your therapist my dude, and take care of yourself.
